主要内容: On March 20, 2014, Steve G Mihaylo, a member of the board of directors of Internet America, Inc., notified the company of his resignation effective immediately. He indicated that his resignation was not due to any disagreements with the company or its operations, policies, or practices. Substantially concurrent with his resignation, the company received a letter from Crexendo (AMEX: EXE), of which Mr. Mihaylo is Chairman and CEO, expressing interest in acquiring all of the outstanding shares of Internet America at a price of $0.80 per share, payable in shares of Crexendo’s common stock. The company’s Board of Directors has engaged legal counsel and is in the process of engaging a financial advisor to evaluate strategic alternatives in light of Crexendo’s expressed interest.
